[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested staying hydrated with refillable water bottles and healthy snacks, avoiding sugary drinks and foods that can lead to energy crashes.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended getting enough rest before the trip, aiming for 7-8 hours of sleep.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested creating a playlist or audiobook for entertainment during the drive.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised avoiding driving during natural sleepiness peak hours (usually 2-4 pm and 12-2 am).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested packing a portable Wi-Fi hotspot for internet access during the trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Benefits of a portable Wi-Fi hotspot include staying connected in rural areas, accessing real-time traffic updates, and emergency assistance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended considering factors like coverage, data limits, battery life, and speed when choosing a portable Wi-Fi hotspot.
